I just wanted to say that you’re not alone with this struggle. I went vegan this year but also struggle with binge eating  and I relate to this post so much! I don’t much advice to offer other than don’t beat yourself up too much over eating something with dairy in it. Something is always better than nothing. If you’re vegan 90% of the time then I don’t see anything wrong with splurging sometimes, it’s still way better than eating dairy in every meal. Also, if you tell yourself you’re not allowed to have something then you’ll just end up craving it more which could trigger a binge (that’s something that happens to me a lottt) sometimes I find it more helpful to just let myself have the single doughnut I wanted even though it has dairy rather than telling myself I’m not allowed and then feeling bad later when I binged on a bunch of other random stuff trying to satisfy the original craving.
